== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Windwatcher is a rare and near-mythical [[Kameira]], an iridescent bird-like creature characterized by its massive wingspan of at least forty yards. Its physical appearance is described as a work of living art, featuring feathers that glisten with rainbow-like colors, a beak resembling spun glass, and eyes that glow like distant stars. These creatures possess the ability to manipulate air currents, nudging updrafts and catching winds to lift themselves higher into the sky. While some accounts suggest they became extinct centuries ago, they have been known to serve as personal companions to high-ranking individuals, such as [[General Teach]]. They are also capable of being soulbound to specific items, such as boots that use [[Windwatcher feathers]] to control the wind for the wearer.}}
